A request to reply with factual details does not automatically support Contact and Conversation. Do not create industry-specific or provider-specific versions of an interaction. Evaluate the named categories below; do not invent narrower categories or fill a label quota. If no category is supported, the email can be labelled Undetermined. Does the complete email express the following interaction: conveying substantive news, status updates, or results to the recipient, rather than merely containing information? There must be an independently substantive update or result; routine explanations or instructions supporting another interaction are not sufficient by themselves. TASK: For each example, please evaluate the PROMPT by generating a 1-sentence RATIONALE of your thought process and providing a resulting ANSWER of ONE of the following multiple-choice options, including just the letter: - A: Strongly agree - B: Agree - C: Neither agree nor disagree - D: Disagree - E: Strongly disagree Please also include one 1-sentence QUOTE exactly copied from the example that illustrates this pattern.
